title: Mass Destruction
overview:
Don't just sit there... Shoot!

Take command of a battle tank in an overhead action shooter. Each mission sends you after a set target that must be destroyed while enemy forces try to stop you, with optional secondary objectives that earn bonus points and can open up secret bonus missions. The turret turns independently of the hull, so you can drive one way and fire another.

- 24 missions, plus hidden bonus missions
- Three tank classes - Cheetah, Cobra and Viper - with different firepower, armor and speed
- Flame throwers, guided missiles, mortars, mines, vortex bombs and more, some with limited ammunition
- Buildings and terrain can be blown apart
